    Essential path contours and arrow occurrences #

    Package the occurrence conditions used around BGRS Lemma 8.4. An essential contour is a related pair outside one interlacement class. Prefix triviality in a quiver prevents an initial occurrence from recurring in the remaining tail. For the reversed ray quiver, the direct translation of the source's left-to-right path prefix is instead the suffix-triviality predicate below.

            def LargeIndecomposable.EssentialContourArrowPrefixTrivial {Q : Type u} [Quiver Q] (R : PathContourRelation Q) (I : PathInterlacementRelation R) (a : BundledQuiverArrow Q) :

              def LargeIndecomposable.EssentialContourArrowSuffixTrivial {Q : Type u} [Quiver Q] (R : PathContourRelation Q) (I : PathInterlacementRelation R) (a : BundledQuiverArrow Q) :
              Prop

              The orientation-dual occurrence condition: the path after the selected arrow is an identity in every essential contour. For the reversed ray quiver this is the direct translation of BGRS 8.4, because BGRS composes paths from left to right in the underlying ray category.
